data.body: Ticket 4 (patriotic-abdicative-arrowana) implemented: adapter.py::_translate_findings carries blocking:bool (splitting the single flattened loop into two labeled passes) instead of severity; _render_review_text shows BLOCKING/ADVISORY when decision present, falls back to severity unchanged for scan-spec findings (decision absent); _render_plan_review_text's advisory branch drops the sev= suffix. finding_publish.py confirmed zero diff throughout. TDD: 2 happy-path tests given to implementer subagent (1 attempt, clean), 1 held-out test (the exact spec-scan-fallback-preservation case the gate caught twice) restored and validated GREEN after implementation -- confirms the implementer's fix correctly preserved the case it never saw. Mutation-teeth check in sandbox (flipped True->False on the blocking-pass label, confirmed RED "assert False is True", restored via targeted Edit this time -- not git checkout --). Lint/format/typecheck clean (one trivial import-order autofix in my own test file). Committed (rebar-ticket: 96f9-e324-c22f-49a2), pushed to Gerrit: https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/2452.
